items.title: Somalia: Ambassador Daccò Coppi Meets with the Minister of Information
items.description: (ANSA) - NAIROBI, 08 LUG - The Italian Ambassador to Somalia, Pier Mario Daccò Coppi, met with the Somali Minister of Information, Culture, and Tourism, Abdifatah Qasim, with whom he visited the National Theater and the headquarters of Somali state radio and television. The National Theater is a building dating back to the 1960s that retains considerable architectural value within Mogadishu’s urban landscape and serves as a cultural landmark that the authorities hope to revitalize and promote after more than 35 years of inactivity. Minister Qasim emphasized the importance of cultural promotion

items.description: (ANSA) - QUITO, 08 LUG - The Italian Ambassador to Ecuador, Giovanni Davoli, attended as a guest of honor at the signing of the agreement between Ecuador’s “Contraloría General” (Court of Auditors) and the Itajus legal diplomacy program. The Contraloría General thus joins the long list of Ecuadorian institutions receiving assistance from Italian legal diplomacy, in the form of support and training for its officials, amid the security crisis the country is facing due to the mafia’s offensive. The Contralor General, Xavier Torres, expressed his gratitude to the Italian government for its support
items.titleIt: Ambassador Davoli signed a cooperation agreement with the Court of Auditors of Ecuador

items.title: Spain bad, Italy good, beyond minor disagreements NATO united says Trump
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 8 - Spain has been bad while Italy has been good and NATO as a whole has been good despite minor disagreements with the United States, President Donald Trump said after a summit in Ankara on Wednesday. "Spain was bad, Italy was good, and almost everyone was good; they had a bad moment," he said referring to lack of support for the Iran war. "Beyond minor disagreements, we love each other." The president then reaffirmed the unity within NATO: "I've never seen anything like it." (ANSA). Read article...
